description: Generate a map with multiple pinned locations. Example: markers=[{"label": "Tokyo Tower", "link": "https://www.tokyotower.co.jp/"}, {"label": "Zojoji Temple"}].

markers.description: Locations to pin on the map. At least one required.

label.description: Place name to geocode and display.

link.description: Optional: the marker's official website URL, if known. See server instructions.

name.description: Optional: display name for the map. If omitted, the server derives one automatically from place/markers.

place.description: Optional: place to center the map on. If omitted, the center is computed automatically from the markers.

name: generate_markers_map
title: Generate a map with markers
